mood: Dreamy and dense: a pixel-art danmaku nightscape where beautiful curtains of bullets bloom around a tiny dreamer.

shape.borderStyle: 2px solid with a pixel stair-step corner (box-shadow, no blur)
shape.texture: CRT scanlines at 12% opacity over a violet gradient

buttonStyle: Primary is a pink block with a darker pink bottom edge (3px) and white pixel text that nudges down 3px when pressed; secondary is a violet block with a cyan text label.
backdrop: Violet-to-magenta gradient with a few hundred tiny stars and one slow rotating ring of coloured dots (a static CSS radial pattern rotated with transform), safe and cheap.
motion: Gentle, slow drifts only; nothing flashes or pulses faster than once per second (WCAG 2.3.1), and all ambient motion stops when the user picks reduced motion.
